# PDF.js

Unmodified `pdfjs-dist` 5.6.205: `build/pdf.min.mjs`, `build/pdf.worker.min.mjs`.
Upstream: https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js (Mozilla contributors).
License: Apache-2.0, included in `LICENSE`. Copied from the installed, pinned workspace dependency.

Served locally with no CDN or runtime network fetch. This viewer handles only PDFs produced by the trusted application template, with embedded fonts and Unicode maps. It disables eval and WASM; it is not a general-purpose arbitrary-PDF import feature.
